svg.title: tyg running in a terminal
svg.desc: A 9x9 board of dots with the character ^ and a treasure x, over the lines "Treasures: 0 of 10" and "a/d turn s step h j k l or arrows move q quit". The animation walks the character up and right onto the treasure, turns it in place, steps it forward, and bumps it into the top edge, where it turns 180 degrees.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
